summary: Defines the Entity Attestation Token, an attested claims set describing the state and characteristics of an entity such as a phone, IoT device or network equipment. A relying party uses it to decide how much to trust the entity. It is carried as a CBOR Web Token or a JSON Web Token.

eli5.summary: A device hands over a signed report card about itself, so someone can decide how far to trust it.
